absolute_note: mean_excess_pct in this section is the plain mean forward return of the event coin (1% winsorised), not relative to peers. baseline_mean_pct is the average liquid coin over the same period. Cost columns subtract an assumed round trip for a long-only buy at the event-day close.

features.near_prior_high: close within 10% of the prior 30-day high
features.closed_at_extreme: close in the move's direction: top 25% of range (up) / bottom 25% (down)
features.broad_market_day: share of liquid coins with a positive day >= 60%

design.replicates_means: Bonferroni p<0.05 over all tests in discovery, AND Bonferroni p<0.05 in test over only the discovery survivors, AND same sign
design.post_hoc: The volatility_matched adjustment and the stricter test-period family were added after the first run, which showed up and down moves both lagging the market average.
